WEEK 1 — Number Fundamentals
Thursday — Quantitative Review
3h 15m

* Read Quantitative Review: Integers & Number Properties
* Learn natural numbers, integers, positive/negative numbers
* Learn odd/even numbers
* Learn prime and composite numbers
* Learn factors and multiples
* Learn divisibility rules
* Solve easy practice questions
* Review every incorrect question
* Add mistakes to GMAT Error Log

Saturday — Quant + Official Guide
3h

* Recall Thursday's concepts without notes
* Quantitative Review: Factors, multiples & primes practice
* Solve 10–15 targeted Quant questions
* Review incorrect questions
* Official Guide: introductory Quant questions
* Identify question type for each question
* Record difficult questions for reattempt

Sunday 7:00 — Verbal + DI
2h 15m

* Verbal Review: Understand argument structure
* Learn premise vs conclusion
* Learn evidence vs conclusion
* Practice identifying conclusions
* Solve 8–10 CR questions
* DI Review: Tables
* Practice reading rows, columns and units
* Solve basic table questions

Sunday 9:30 — Weekly Review
2h 15m

* 30 min Quant revision
* 30 min Quant mixed practice
* 30 min Verbal revision
* 30 min DI practice
* Review entire week's error log
* Reattempt 3–5 previously incorrect questions

WEEK 12 — Foundation Assessment
This week is different.
Thursday

* Quant revision
* Review all formulas/concepts
* Review Quant error log
* Reattempt previously incorrect questions

Saturday
Foundation Quant Test

* 30 Quant questions
* Timed conditions
* Record accuracy
* Record time/question
* Don't look at solutions until finished

Sunday 7:00
Foundation Verbal + DI Test

* 20 Verbal questions
* 15 DI questions
* Timed conditions
* Record accuracy
* Record timing

Sunday 9:30
Analysis

* Classify every mistake
* Concept errors
* Logic errors
* Strategy errors
* Timing errors
* Careless errors
* Identify weakest Quant topics
* Identify weakest Verbal topics
* Identify weakest DI topics
* Create Phase 2 priorities
